inputs.issue_title: Add timeout to HTTP client in github package
inputs.plan: Modify github/client.go to add a configurable timeout to the HTTP client. Default to 30 seconds.
inputs.gathered_context: github/client.go creates http.Client without timeout. Config struct has no timeout field yet.
inputs.conventions: Use time.Duration for timeouts. Default constants at top of file.

assertions.value:
Check the generated Go code against these criteria:
1. Sets a Timeout field on the http.Client struct (not on http.Transport or context)
2. The default timeout value is 30 seconds (30 * time.Second or time.Duration equivalent)
3. The timeout is configurable (accepted as a parameter, config field, or option)
4. Does not remove or break existing client functionality (the code modifies, not rewrites)
